verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists, but the pack shows only a 14-day free trial and feature tiers. A community report mentions a free tier, pay-as-you-go usage beyond it, and a $1200/month next plan, which hints at usage-based pricing without showing actual per-unit rates. Another community report says self-hosted RAM needs were too unpredictable to plan costs, which cuts against cost predictability. Missing for 10: documented per-search/per-record/per-node rates, a cost calculator or worked pricing examples, independent confirmation that costs are predictable before committing.
